title: Cervical Pre-Meditation
summary: Daily, right before meditation, breathing or vagus work. Frees the neck and thoracic outlet. No end-range neck rotation; stop if ring/pinky numbness worsens.

steps.name: Scalene Stretch
steps.cue: Hand just below collarbone, press down to anchor it. Tilt ear toward the opposite shoulder and breathe. Gentle, never forced. Stop if ring/pinky tingling increases.

steps.name: SCM Self-Release
steps.cue: Turn head 45° away. Gently pinch the rope-like muscle (ear to collarbone); hold light, still pressure, working top to bottom. No rubbing; stay off the pulse. Stop if dizzy.

steps.name: Wall Angels
steps.cue: Back to wall, feet a few inches out. Head, upper back and low back stay on the wall. Slide arms from goalpost to overhead and back, 3 sec each way. Towel behind head if needed.
